LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE PRONOUNS: PERSONAL AND POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.3: Grammar in use Pronouns: Personal and Possessive pronouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in use Pronouns: Personal and Possessive pronouns, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why or how do words replace names of people or things in sentences? 2. Why or how do we use words to show that something belongs to us?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in use Pronouns: Personal and Possessive pronouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: articulating signs clearly as learner constructs sentences through signing, with peers.

• Self-efficacy: knowing who I am as learner gains confidence and high self-esteem when working individually.

Values:
● Responsibility: Accountability, is developed as the learner discovers causes of minor accidents and the first aid procedures to be applied.

● Love: caring is promoted the learners share experiences about accidents and how first aid procedures are undertaken to help survivors.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to connect the concept of personal safety and first aid to their learning in Integrated Science and Science and Technology.

Suggested learning resources:

Newspaper, magazine ,poems, mobile device or a tablet ,course books, signed audio-visual recordings.
